title: The Sessions doc says each session displays a Bounce Status, but no session field of any name carries it
statement: sessions.mdx lists Bounce Status, whether the user left after one page, among the fields each session displays. The sessions response type declares forty-odd fields and none of them is a bounce of any name, and a live response on a site with one genuine single-pageview visit contains no key matching /bounc/i and not even the substring 'bounc'. The bounce metric does exist at the site level in the overview, so this is a documented per-session field that the product does not ship, not a missing feature.

handVerified.note: Report section 7, both halves: the doc is wrong and the product is self-consistent. Site 36 with one genuine bounce (single pageview) and one two-page visit. GET /api/sites/36/sessions returns 2 rows; the 41 keys of row 0 were dumped in full and none matches /bounc/i; the whole response body does not contain the substring 'bounc'. CONTROL GET /api/sites/36/overview returns bounce_rate 50, so the concept exists site-wide. The board scenario fails at step 7 asserting the page text contains 'Bounce' and the rendered Sessions page does not. An incidental observation the report records separately: the live rows carry tag and timezone, which GetSessionsResponse does not declare, and omit page_title and querystring, which it does.

commitsOnCulpritFiles.title: perf(clickhouse): cut mutation-driven parts-lock contention on the hot ingest path
commitsOnCulpritFiles.effect: One hunk only, at getSessions.ts:162-165, repointing the ReplaySessions CTE from session_replay_metadata to session_replay_metadata_v2. The GetSessionsResponse type is untouched.

source.howDecided: git log 613cd015..HEAD on sessions.mdx returns nothing; sessions.mdx:18 still reads '- **Bounce Status** - Whether the user left after one page'. getSessions.ts has exactly one commit and one hunk since the tested commit, at :162-165, unrelated to the response shape. GetSessionsResponse spans :10-:53 at both the tested commit and HEAD (the report's cite of :10-51 is off by two lines at both revisions) and declares no bounce field.

queries: gh api --paginate 'repos/rybbit-io/rybbit/issues?state=all&per_page=100' (not a search; 1044 items, 320 non-PR issues, numbers 1 to 1131 with 87 gaps) then a local regex scan of every issue title plus body
local regex over all 320 issues: bounce  ->  1 hit, #1082 ('IP exclusion not working + same user counted as multiple sessions'), which mentions bounce rate in passing and is unrelated

reevaluation: The finding stands, source untouched, still unreported. It is the cheapest of the doc-side set to verify and to fix: one bullet in sessions.mdx either goes away or the product grows a per-session bounce flag, and since a reader can already derive it from pageviews == 1 the honest ask is to fix the doc and, optionally, to surface the derived status in the UI. Re-verification adds nothing that changes scope or severity. One thing a filer should carry across from the report even though it is not part of this finding: GetSessionsResponse has drifted from the payload it types, declaring page_title and querystring that the live rows omit and omitting tag and timezone that they carry. That is a separate observation, it should not be smuggled into this issue's body, and if it is worth raising it deserves its own thread.
notes: Report section 7 (a deliberate red; the report gives it no F id). Doc-side finding, and the weakest of the ten on its own. The docs live in this same repo under docs/content/docs, so there is no separate docs repo and no 'docs repo issue' route: a doc fix here is a one-line PR against rybbit-io/rybbit. Five of the ten findings (R6, R7, R8, R9, R10) are doc-side. Filing five separate doc issues would burn maintainer patience for little gain; consider one consolidated 'documentation does not match behaviour' issue listing all five with file and line, or a single PR. If filed alone the body should be short: the doc bullet, the 41 keys of a real session row, the note that the response does not contain the substring 'bounc' anywhere, and the overview control proving bounce_rate exists site-wide so the concept is not missing. Ask for the doc to drop or reword the bullet, and mention that pageviews == 1 already derives it if they would rather add the field. Do NOT include the GetSessionsResponse type-drift observation here; keep this issue to one claim. rybbit-io/rybbit applies NO labels: all 40 most recent issues carry an empty label array, and both templates declare labels: ''. Do not add a 'Suggested labels' line here; there is no vocabulary to copy and it would only add noise. The bug template is a classic markdown template with bold headers (**Describe the bug**, **To Reproduce**, **Expected behavior**, **Screenshots**, **Desktop**, **Smartphone**, **Additional context**), not a YAML form, and no template-enforcing workflow exists, so there is no auto-close bot to trip.
